ctx.link.note: ledger row: ctx.link (Hyperlink) — ctx Link opens #link-dialog in insert mode (editor.js insertLink); no post: the runner clicks post before checkEffect, which would close the dialog under assertion

ctx.edit-link.note: needs link-at-caret pre — editLinkAtSelection early-returns via setStatus('… editLink') when anchorAtSelection() finds no <a href> inside the selection (editor.js:2997-3003); the ctx-menu pre cannot build link state, so the promised #link-dialog edit mode never appears

ctx.remove-link.note: needs link-at-caret pre — removeLinkAtSelection early-returns via setStatus('… removeLink') when anchorAtSelection() finds no <a href> at the selection (editor.js:3015-3021); unlinking an anchor that cannot be planted is unassertable

ctx.clear-field.note: ctx-menu-on-field pre plants span.page-number[data-field=page] ('1') and right-clicks it, un-hiding the data-showif="field" row (index.html:1663, editor.js:9825-9827); ClearField then empties the field at the caret (editor.js:9945-9956, fieldEl.textContent = "") — text-mutation empty:true observes the cleared text

ctx.update-field.note: pilot pattern (ctx.follow-move): UpdateField runs fieldOpAtSelection('update'), whose observable contract is the wo:field-op window CustomEvent (editor.js:3067-3078, 10185-10186); contract-runner arms a window listener for it (contract-runner.cjs:755)

ctx.edit-field.note: pilot pattern (ctx.follow-move): EditField runs fieldOpAtSelection('edit') — the promised #field-dialog edit slice is unimplemented, so the observable contract is the wo:field-op window CustomEvent (editor.js:3067-3078, 10187-10188); contract-runner arms a window listener for it (contract-runner.cjs:755)

ctx.toggle-field-codes.note: pilot pattern (ctx.follow-move): ToggleFieldCodes runs fieldOpAtSelection('toggle-codes') — no field-code view toggle exists in the DOM model, so the observable contract is the wo:field-op window CustomEvent (editor.js:3067-3078, 10189-10190); contract-runner arms a window listener for it (contract-runner.cjs:755)

ctx.content-control-settings.note: needs content-control-at-caret pre — ContentControlSettings dispatches wo:content-control-settings then early-returns via setStatus(NoContentControl) when contentControlAtSelection() finds no span.content-control at the caret (editor.js:10205-10208); #cc-dialog never opens without planted content-control state
